name: Jachin
overview: The name Jachin appears in Scripture with multiple references, primarily connected to the tribe of Simeon and the priesthood. He is identified as a son of Simeon, also called Jarib, from whom the family of the Jachinites descended, as seen in Genesis 46:10, Exodus 6:15, and Numbers 26:12. Additionally, Jachin is noted as a priest who returned from exile to Jerusalem and served as a leader of one of the priestly courses, highlighting his role in the restoration and order of worship in Nehemiah 11:10.
